# Dark Slide Design Balance , design-balance rules and checks for dark-background Marp decks

Curated by Skill Harbor: a field-tested set of design-balance rules for building slides on a dark Marp theme: measure margins before nudging them, keep vertical rhythm with real numbers, pick colors by luminance ratio against black (not by feel), use the settled designs for tables, code panels and callout boxes, avoid Marp-specific traps, and run the inspection scripts after every export. by @minorun365, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the skill content is written in Japanese (the rules themselves are language-independent); it expects Marp, the minorun-dark theme and the repo's check scripts (mutool, Python) to be available. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
